```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(here)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
df <- read.csv(here::here("DataRaw", "Week_07_VA_Data.csv"))
#no 38 value for 6 months
table(df$sixmonth, useNA = "always") %>% prop.table()

tbl_summary(df)

filter(df, is.na(proced)) %>% head()

table(is.na(df$proced), is.na(df$weight))

hist(df$asa)

weight_df <- df %>% filter(weight < 100)
tbl_summary(weight_df)
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = weight, y = height)) + geom_point()
```
